header_sentences: See Arm, Force, Hand, Horn, Lion, Mighty one, Omnipotence, Rod, Shoulder, Strength.

contexts.text: He is called God from His power. Illustrated.
His Own power. Signified, Explained.
(The act of Uzzah) represented Own power, or the proprium. AC 878:8.
Many who have lived in power... are among the blessed...
For power is of the will.
Hand = power; arm = still greater power; and shoulder, all power. Illustrated.
The reputation of power thence. Signified, Explained.

(The Lord acting during glorification from His Own power.) AC 1573:4. AC 1607:end. AC 1616:5. AC 1661:5. AC 1692. AC 1736. AC 1737. AC 1752. AC 1787. AC 1793. AC 1813. AC 1820. AC 1920. AC 1921. AC 1988. AC 2004. AC 2025. AC 2083. AC 2093. AC 2107. AC 2500. AC 2523. AC 2540. AC 2551. AC 2557. AC 2574. AC 2576:18. AC 2625. AC 2636. AC 2643. AC 2665. AC 2772. AC 2798. AC 3026. AC 3036. AC 3043. AC 3125. AC 3161. AC 3281. AC 3322. AC 3740. AC 3927:2. AC 3975. AC 4065. AC 4168. AC 4251. AC 4287. AC 4641. AC 5005. AC 5041. AC 5045. AC 5157:end. AC 6716. AC 9486, Illustrated. AC 9715:3, Signified. DLord 14, Signified. DLord 33. AR 265, Signified. AE 309, Signified.
Man cannot resist from his Own power...
The things procured by Own power are said to be born in the house.
The Lord from His Own power gave the Angels force, and as it were power, to fight with Him; for all the power the Angels have is from the Lord.
When he sees the immensity of heaven, he thinks... of the infinite power of the Lord.
To sit at the right hand of power = to have all Power in the Heavens and on earth.
The hand, or palm, = power.

When anxiety and grief are induced on them from the fact that they can do nothing from themselves, and this to despair, the Persuasive is broken, and the state is changed, and they can be brought into the belief that... all power, prudence, intelligence, and wisdom, are from the Lord.
The strength of a horse = Own power of thinking truth; the legs of a man = Own power of doing good.
When the power of Divine good, or omnipotence, is treated of, He is called Jehovah Zebaoth, and Lord.
From the power of good, men and Angels are also called lords. In the opposite sense, those are called servants who have no power, or who have power from the others.
Prince of God = the Lord as to the power of truth.
The power here treated of is from truth... In the Word, power is especially attributed to truth... The power which appears to be from truth, is itself from good, through truth.
The power of the affection of truth. Signified.
But with men, truth is never conjoined with good by Own power, but by the Lord's power. Explained.

One Angel has more power than myriads of infernal Spirits; not from himself, but from the Lord; and he has it... in proportion as he believes that he can do nothing from himself... and this he can believe in proportion as he is in humiliation and in the affection of being of service to others...
Goods and truths have in them all power from the Lord; and therefore the Angels also are called powers.
God is predicated from ability, or power.
Ability is predicated of truth, when being is predicated of good; for good has power by truth. Explained.
Own power, in the supreme sense. Signified. AC 3975. AC 3977.
But man never sustains any spiritual temptation... from his Own power...
To know the animus and power. Signified, Explained.
The Divine of the Lord's Natural as to the good of truth, to which belongs power. Signified.
From Own power, or, what is the same, from self. Signified.
The Own power of natural good. Signified, Explained.
The derivative power of natural Truths. Signified.
The disposition of the power of interior truth. Signified. It is the power of the spiritual man in the natural. Explained.
(Hence) power is predicated of truth... Not that there is power in truth from itself; but in good, and thus in truth from good; that is, in truth through good from the Lord.
The powers of the heavens shall be shaken () = that the foundations of the Church (will) perish.
With power and great glory () = (the revelation) of the internal sense, in which is the Lord... Power is predicated of the good, and glory, of the truth, therein.
To serve... when predicated of the Lord, = Own power.
That all things were from His Own power, and nothing given by anyone. Signified. AC 4182.
In the particulars there are singulars in potency.

As El, and Elohim = the Lord as to truth, they also = Him as to power; for truth is that of which power is predicated; for good acts through truth when it is exercising power; and therefore when power from truth is treated of, the Lord is called El, and Elohim, or God. Hence, too, it is, that El, in the Original, = the Mighty One.

In Heaven, he who... believes from the heart ... that nothing of power is from himself, but that all the power he has is from the Lord, is called the least, and yet is the greatest, because he has power from the Lord. AC 4459:4.
Everything of power in good is through truth.
Naphtali, in the supreme sense, = Own power.
(A miser) regards himself as the greatest in power.
Power is ascribed to truth, because good exercises power through truth...
For in the other life, truths have power with them.
Power is predicated of truth. References.
The power (of good) hidden. Signified.

Those in the Grand Man who correspond to the hands, arms, and shoulders, are those who are in power through the truth of faith from good; for those in (this) are in the power of the Lord; for they attribute all power to Him... and, in proportion as, not with the mouth, but with the heart, they attribute no power to themselves, they are in greater power. Hence the Angels are called powers, and Powers.
That from the Celestial of the Spiritual is everything of power in the Spiritual. Signified.
And everything of power in the Natural. Signified, Explained.
The nature of angelic power. Explained.

He is the most powerful, who believes, wills, and perceives that everything of power is from the Lord, and none from himself; and therefore those who are powers in Heaven are utterly averse to all power from themselves.
Without any power of theirs. Signified. AC 5496. AC 5664.
As faith in the understanding... has but little power to be trusted in (there is signified) as much as was in his power.
Truth received in the powers; (that is) in the faculties of receiving. Signified.
That they would no longer procure truths by Own power... Treated of.
Influx into the power of his obscure apperception. Signified, Explained.
That through (faith) good has power. Signified, Explained.
As to power; namely, the power of thinking and willing, of perceiving, of doing good, of believing, of dissipating falsities and evils, it is all from good by means of truth.
Strength = the power in good; but forces, the power of truth.
The beginning of my forces = that through faith is the first power in truth. Explained.
In , strength is predicated of good; forces, of truth; power, of both.

That through faith there is power in good, and the first power in truth, (is thus). All the power in the Spiritual World is from good through truth. Without good, truth has nothing whatever of power; for truth is like the body, and good the soul thereof; for the soul to effect anything it must be through the body. (Thus) truth without good has no power whatever... When the faith of truth is first born through good, there then appears power in truth; and this power is what is called the first power in truth through faith. Illustrated.

What the power in truth from good is, can scarcely be known to anyone in the world; but to those in the other life; thus from] revelation thence. Those who are in truth from good... are in power through truth from good. In this power are all the Angels; and therefore they are called powers; for they are in the power of restraining evil Spirits; one Angel thousands at once. They exert their power especially with man, by defending him, sometimes against many Hells, and this in a thousand and a thousand ways. They have this power through the truth which is of faith from the good which is of charity. But as they have faith from the Lord, it is the Lord alone who is power with them.
This power, which, through faith, is from the Lord, is meant by the Lord's words to Peter...
In heavenly order is all power. Signified.
What great power there is in truth. (From experience).
He prevailed over the power of the doctrine of falsity from evil. Signified, Explained.
That the power of those of the Spiritual Church shall not prevail against them. Signified.
Power from the Divine. Signified.
The media of Divine power against falsities. Signified.
The power of the Lord's Divine Human. Signified, Explained.
Hand = the power proceeding from His Divine Rational; rod = the power proceeding from His Divine Natural.
The influx of the power of the Divine Natural into the Sensuous. Signified.
By the Divine power of the Lord is here meant the Divine truth proceeding from Him; for in Divine truth there is power, insomuch that it is power itself. Explained.
The power of elevating from the ultimate of the Sensuous. Signified, Explained.
That the power, then, was communicated from the Divine. Signified.
Spiritual power consists in truth.
Divine power in truths. Signified.
A bringing forth from Hell by Divine power. Signified, Explained.
Elevation to Heaven by Divine power. Signified, Explained.
The power of the law Divine over those in falsities. Signified, Explained.
Signs and prodigies = the media of Divine power.
That they will be driven by the Divine power. Signified.
When they observe the Divine power against them. Signified.
The power which is being shown. Signified. AC 7295.
They thus exercise magical power.
Power from order to make dull as to the apperception of truth. Signified, Explained.
The power taken away from them. Signified.
The angelic power from the Lord is so great that...
Power like the former. Signified.
Hand = spiritual power, from which is the natural power, which is the rod.
Power over the falsities which are from fallacies. Signified.
Power over the falsities which are with the infesters. Signified.
To exercise spiritual power through the Natural. Signified.
Mighty power against falsities. Signified.
In truths is power, insomuch that it cannot be resisted. References.

The Divine truth proceeding from the Lord has in it all power. Hence it is that also in the truths which are in the ultimates of order there is power; and therefore the evil acquire power for themselves through truths...
The power of internal truth through external truth. Signified, Explained.
That he should show the Divine power. Signified.
This is the finger of God = that the power was from the Divine.
Elevation to a still greater sign of power. Signified, Explained.
The manifestation of Divine power thence for ever. Signified.
Power given in so far as it can be received. Signified.
The dominion of power. Signified.
The dominion of power of truth Divine over the whole Natural of the infesters. Signified.
Such power has the Divine truth which proceeds from the Divine good, that all things in the universe have been created by it. Explained.
Hand = the will, here; because all the power of action... proceeds from the will.
The dominion of power where is the Hell of falsity from evil. Signified.
The dominion of power of truth Divine over Hell. Signified, Explained.

It is said the dominion of power of truth Divine, because all Divine power is through the truth which proceeds from the Lord. Signified. In a word, Divine truth has in it all power, insomuch that it is power itself. Some in the other life who are pre-eminently in truth are in such power thence that they can go through the Hells without danger... And there are some who through truth from the Divine exercise power magically.
Good with truth... being Divine, has all power; but (evil with falsity) being infernal, has nothing of power.
The power of injecting falsities taken away. Signified.
Wheels = the power of advancing. Explained, Illustrated.
That everything of power is from Him. Signified.
That from Him are all the media through which is power. Signified.

Those in this truth were led into the truths of His worship, which are the media of power; for all power in the spiritual sense is in the truths which are from the Divine. Power, in the spiritual sense, is to put to flight and cast out from ourselves the infernal crew, which is done only through truths.
That the Divine power of the Lord has elevated them to Heaven into the Divine there. Signified, Explained.
The difference of power is what is signified by the numerous and the few.
An omer = as much as is sufficient; and thus power.
The highest degree of power. Signified, Explained.
The Divine power through which falsities have been dissipated. Signified.

It is said power thence, because in truth combating there is power from good; for all the power in truth is from the good which is in it. The reason is, that the Divine is in good, and through good in truth...
To elevate the hand = to determine spiritual power upwards, thus to the Lord... and spiritual power is faith; for all power in the Spiritual World is of truth from good, or of faith from charity.
That the power of looking upwards to the Lord failed. Signified.
The diminution of power with those in falsity from interior evil. Signified.
Infernal Genii... have no power at all against the Divine: the least of Divine power masters... the diabolical crew in a moment...
Perception then from truth Divine concerning the power of the Lord's Divine Human against those who were in falsities and infested. Signified.
Wings = the powers which are of spiritual truth from its good. Explained.
That power is of spiritual truth from good. References.
The power of truth from the Divine to prepare them to receive the Divine. Signified.
Imaginary power from the intellectual proprium. Signified.
Rod of bread = power from good; rod of water = power from truth.
If anyone ill-treats scientific truth or its affection from his Own power. Signified, Explained.
A spear = interior power.
All power in the Spiritual World is from the truths which are from good; thus from the truths which proceed from the Lord. Explained.
As all power is of truth, it follows that there is no power at all in falsity from evil... and therefore those in Hell... have no power whatever...
That those in the external sense of the Word separated from the internal have not truth in its power. Signified, Explained.
Keys = power. Illustrated.

What truth in its power is. Explained. It is known that the Angels are called powers, and also that they are powers; yet they are not powers from themselves, but from the Lord, and because they are recipients of the truth Divine which is from the Lord. They have from the Lord such power that one of them can drive away... a thousand of the diabolical crew...
To remain in a state of power over others. Signified.
The staves of the ark = the power thence. AC 9539.
The staves in the rings = the power of the Divine sphere.
The six reeds from the candlestick = the power of truth from good as to all things in the Spiritual Heaven... Reeds = truths from good, and the derivative power.
The candlestick = the medium by which is conjunction, and from which is power.
That (these) powers shall be from the Divine Spiritual. Signified.
Power through truth from good. Signified.
All in Heaven are called powers; and also are powers from the fact that they are receptions of the Divine truth which is from the Lord.
(Thus) good is faculty, but it is determined only by means of truth. Determined faculty is actual power; consequently, is supporting power. Signified.
The staves of Shittim wood = the power of truth from good... The Lord's good of merit is the only good which reigns in Heaven, and consequently from which there is power in truths.
The primary power, from which the powers are everywhere continued. Signified, Explained.
As the Lord did this from His Own power, He alone has merit and justice...
The horns on the four corners = power in every way.
That the power must be from good. Signified.
The power of holding together in a state of good. Signified.
The power of the sphere of Divine good. Signified.
The power of good from which is truth, and of truth from good. Signified.
That all the power of good is through truth. References.
That Divine power itself is Divine truth. Reference.
Power, then, from celestial good. Signified.
That power and strength consist in ultimates. Representation and Explained.
Inauguration to represent the Lord's Divine power through Divine truth from Divine good. Signified.

The Lord's Divine power (here represented) is the Divine power of saving the human race; and the power of saving the human race is power over the Heavens and Hells; for through this power, and through no other power, is man saved. Explained.
Power, being the Active of life... AC 10023:end.
The Lord's Divine power from proprium. Signified.
The power itself of Divine truth from Divine good (was thus represented); for through the power of Divine truth from Divine good all things take place...
A representative of the Lord's Divine power in the Heavens through Divine truth from Divine good. Signified.
A representative of the Lord's plenary power in the Heavens through the influx from the Divine good of the Divine love of His Divine Human. Signified.
The powers of truth from the good of love and of charity. Signified, Explained.
That all power is of truth from the good of love. Explained.
The power of Divine truth is also meant by the voice of Jehovah... (and) by the Word.
That in truths from good is all power, and in falsities from evil no power, is very well known in the other life...

That there is such power in truths from good cannot be apprehended by those who have the idea of truth and its faith as of something merely cogitative, when yet the Cogitative of man from his Voluntary makes all the strength of the body, and if it was inspired, by the Lord through His Divine truth, man would have the strength of Samson; but it pleases the Lord that man should have strength through faith from love as to those things which are of his spirit, and conduce to eternal salvation.
The power of truth from good there. Signified.
The power from the good of love of the Lord.
Without all power of resisting the evils which are from Hell. Signified, Explained.

The reason those in externals separated from what is internal have no power to resist the evils and falsities from Hell, is that all the power to resist them is from the Divine; and therefore those who are separated from what is internal... have no power. Described, Representation.
In Heaven, all power is in Divine truth; and without it there is no power at all. References.
All the Angels, from Divine truth, are called powers; and also in proportion as they are receptions or receptacles of it, they are powers. Described.

That there is such power in Divine truth cannot be believed by those who have no other idea of truth than as of thought or discourse, in which there is no power in itself, except in so far as others do it from obedience. But Divine truth has power in itself, and such power, that through it Heaven and the world were created, with all things in them.
That there is such power in Divine truth, may be illustrated by... the power of truth and good in man; and by the power of heat and light from the sun in the world. Explained.
Concerning the power of the Angels of Heaven. Chapter.
(Such) know that all the power man has is from bis understanding and will. Explained.
The nature of the power which the Angels have with man. Explained.
But the power of the Angels in the Spiritual World is so great that... it surpasses belief. Described.
That the Angels have a like power in the natural world, when it is granted. Illustrated.
As the Angels have such power, they are called powers. Illustrated.

(But) the Angels have no power whatever from themselves; but all the power they have is from the Lord; and they are powers in proportion as they acknowledge this. Whoever of them believes that he has power from himself, instantly becomes so weak, that he cannot resist one evil Spirit.

It is the Divine truth proceeding from the Lord which has all power in the Heavens... and in proportion as the Angels are receptions of it, they are powers... So far, therefore, as an Angel is truth from the Divine and good from the Divine, so far he is a power, because so far the Lord is with him... (Thus) one Angel is not in the like power as another.
Those are in the greatest power who constitute the arms in the Grand Man, because they are in truths more than the rest, and into their truths there inflows good from the universal Heaven...

But the Angels are receptions of Divine truth in so far as they are receptions of Divine good; for all power is in truths from good, and none in truths without good; and, also, there is all power in good through truths, and none in good without truths. Power comes forth from the conjunction of both. It is the like with faith and love...
What great power the Angels have through truths from good, is evident from the fact that when an evil Spirit is merely looked at by the Angels he falls into a swoon...

As all power is in truths from good, there is no power whatever in falsities from evil... and therefore those in Hell have no power against truth and good. But the nature of their power among themselves, and the nature of the power of evil Spirits before they are cast into Hell, will be told in what follows.

All power in the Spiritual World is of truth from good, and there is no power whatever of falsity from evil. The reason all power is in truth from good, is that the Divine Itself in Heaven is Divine good and Divine truth, and in the Divine is all power. The reason there is no power whatever of falsity from evil, is that all power is of truth from good, and in falsity from evil there is nothing of truth from good. Hence it is that all power is in Heaven, and none in Hell...
That Divine truth in the sense of the letter... is in its power. General article. DSS 49.
The power of Divine truth is especially against falsities and evils, thus against the Hells... Through the truths with man also the Lord has power to save him...
The Lord's power from the ultimates of truth was represented also by the Nazarites...
That Samson's power was in his hair...
Every man is such that he can shun evils as of himself by the Lord's power, if he implores it; and that which he does afterwards is good from the Lord. DLife 104:end.
That degrees of height in their ultimate are in... power. General article.

Endeavour... through motion... exerts its power... Therefore there is no power in endeavour alone, nor in force alone, but in motion, which is their product... Such is the progression (of endeavour, force, and motion) into power.
The interiors which are of the mind are in no power except through the forces in the body; and neither are the forces in power, except through the action of the body itself.
The two prior degrees are in power through the exteriors of the body...
As such is the evolution and putting forth of the degrees into power...
That the Word in the sense of the letter is in its... power. Explained.
The Lord... took on the Human, in order to put Himself into the power of subjugating the Hells... This power is meant by His sitting at the right hand of the power and virtue of God.
In Jehovah... there was the third degree in potency.
With every man there is a natural, spiritual, and celestial will and understanding in potency from birth.
The spiritual mind, from birth is... only in the potency of being opened.
All the power of good is through truth...
The understanding, from the power given it by the love...

As the evil have nothing of power, the universal Hell is not only as a nothing before the Lord, but is altogether a nothing as to power. But it is wonderful that all the evil believe themselves powerful, and all the good believe themselves not powerful. The reason is that the evil attribute all things to their Own prudence... whereas the good attribute nothing to their Own prudence...
They no longer have rationality in faculty or in potency.
It would be the same with adulteries, unless it were provided that this evil decreases in potency according to the abuse.

The Lord continually inflows with power into the will so that one can shun evils; and with power into the understanding so that one can think that there is a God; but still no one can do the one unless at the same time he does the other. Explained.
In these two things (natural truth, and the natural lumen of man, together) consists the power of truth. Signified.
Thou hast a little power () = they know that they avail nothing from themselves. ( = that they have power from the Lord against evils and falsities. AE 209.)
The Divine truth of the Word as to power. Signified.
The Word as to its powers and guards. Signified.
That sensuous things... appeared to them to have power over all things. Signified, Explained.
The Lord in Divine majesty and power. Signified.
Thou hast taken Thy great power () = the Divine omnipotence which was His from eternity.
Salvation and power () = that now they are saved by the Lord's Divine power.
Much power from the Word continually. Signified.
They deliver their power and Power to the beast () = to ascribe government and dominion over the Church to the Word.
Power be to the Lord our God () = the acknowledgement and confession that the Lord has Power.
Love has power through wisdom. Representation.
What is the life of conjugial love except from the vein of potency...
We have not found the common love of the sex chaste except with these who from love truly conjugial are in continual potency; and these are in the highest Heavens.

Spiritual love exists solely with those who are in love truly conjugial, and thence in eminent potency ... As they are in supereminent potency, they cannot do otherwise than love the sex, and at the same time be averse to what is unchaste. Hence they have the chaste love of the sex, which... derives its sweetness from eminent but still chaste potency. They possess eminent potency from a total renunciation of scortation; and, as the wife alone is loved, it is chaste.
(They said), Is not conjugial love with everyone according to the state of his potency?
(The opinions of the wise from the various kingdoms of Europe concerning the origin of the virtue or potency of conjugial love). CL 104-112.

(The Africans said), You Christians deduce conjugial virtue or potency from various rational and natural causes; but we Africans deduce it from the state of man's conjunction with the God of the universe... When the love is from this state, and this is stable and perpetual, it cannot but operate its own virtue, which is like it, and thus stable and perpetual. Love truly conjugial is known only to those few who are near to God; consequently the potency of this love is known to no others. This potency, with that love, is described by the Angels in the Heavens as the deliciousness of a perpetual spring.
The external Conjugial (then) derives its delight from the blessedness which is in the internal, and at the same time its life, and the deliciousnesses of the potency of this life.
In proportion as anyone loves to be wise for the sake of genuine use, he is in the vein and potency of conjugial love; and, in proportion as he is in these two, he is in deliciousnesses. Described.
That... truly conjugial potency (is possible only with one wife). Explained.
Impotence awaits those who boast of the potency of scortation.
That man is so far in power against evil and falsity from the Divine Omnipotence... as he lives according to Divine order. Explained.
6. It is a law of order that man should purify himself from sins by his own work and power... Explained.

All the virtue and power of God is of Divine truth from Divine good. This is why Jehovah God descended as the Divine truth... according to the words, Gird Thy sword upon Thy thigh, mighty One, and... ride upon the Word of Truth...
All the virtue and power of (the will) is through the understanding...

In the Spiritual World the power of truth is most conspicuous. An Angel who is in Divine truths from the Lord, although as to the body weak as an infant, can put to flight a troop of infernal Spirits... It is the like with men, who are in Divine truths from the Lord... The reason there is such strength in Divine truth, is that... through Divine truth God created the universe; and all the laws of order through which He created it are truths. Signified.
There is such power in (Divine truth from Divine good) that...
The nature of the Lord's power, which He has from Divine good, while He executed the Last Judgment, Described.
The power of truth there is so immense that...
That the power of the Word in ultimates was represented by the Nazarites. General article.
Concerning the ineffable power of the Word. General article.
Then God, through the Human, which was Divine truth, put on all power...
(Thus) the power of Divine truth is ineffable.
No one can purify himself from evils by his Own power, and by his Own forces, and yet it cannot be done without the power and forces of man, as his Own. Explained.
That... supplication for power to resist evils ought to be made. General article.
As the human mind is such as to perceive this no otherwise than that man effects this (cooperation) from his own power, it shall be illustrated.

In man's Passive there is the Lord's Active; and therefore the power of acting well is from the Lord, and the derivative will of acting is as it were man's... (Man can also) act from the power of Hell...
Human minds, thus men themselves, are mere potencies.
That power is obtained solely through vastations. Explained.
[2921b]. Such is their power that myriads would flee for one fly.
That Spirits have nothing of power...
(Spirits) are faculties and powers...
On power, etc., in the other life. Explained.
On the power of the Angels.
Truths alone have power...
Through him they had power.
That falsities have no power against truths.
See Marriage Love or Conjugial Love.
I have said to adulterers that in Heaven there is perpetual potency...

If a man concentrates his love on his wife by shunning adultery as sin, his love then increases daily with its potency; whereas if men take from that love and consume it with harlots, conjugial love becomes like chaff...
So that they might know whether the Lord's power is so great...
In truth from good is all power... Signified.
Power and glory = the Word in the internal sense... It is said that He would come in power, because all power is in Divine truth...
Thine is the kingdom, the power, and the glory = Divine truth from the Lord alone... Power and glory are also said, because in Divine truth is all power and glory.
His face as the sun shineth in its power () = His Divine love from which are all things of Heaven.

All the power of man from his body is transferred into the hands... Hence arms and hands = power; but this power is natural power... But spiritual power is to will the good of another; and, in so far as one can, to want to transfer into him that which is in ourselves: it is this power which is signified by the hand in the spiritual sense, and its communication and transference by to touch with the hand.
Having the key of David = who has power through Divine truth. Explained.

The Lord has all power in the Heavens and on earth from Divine good through Divine truth. For, in general, good without truth has not any power; nor has truth without good; for good acts through truth. Hence it is that the Divine good and Divine truth proceed from the Lord united, and, in proportion as they are received conjointly by the Angels, these are in power.
That they have power from the Lord against evils and falsities in proportion as they make truths from the Word of life, and acknowledge the Divine of the Lord in His Human. Signified, Explained.

Something shall now be said concerning the power which they have from the Lord against evils and falsities. All the power which Angels and also men have is from the Lord; and, in proportion as they receive the Lord, they have power. He who believes that there is power against them from the proprium of man is much mistaken. Explained... In proportion, therefore, as a man is conjoined with the Lord through love, he has power... Those in celestial love have much power; and those in spiritual love have a little power.

But it is to be known that all the power which Angels and men have from the Lord is from the good of love; and, as the good of love does not act from itself, but through truths, therefore all the power is in the good of love through truths; and, with the spiritual, from the good of charity through the truths of faith... Good without truths has no finality, and where there is no quality there is no force or power. (Thus) all power is in good through truths, or in charity through faith, and none in charity without faith, nor in faith without charity. This ia meant by the keys given to Peter. Explained... By (what was said to Peter) is also meant that those have power who acknowledge the Divine of the Lord in His Human, and, from Him, are in the good of charity and thence in the truths of faith.
The power which the Lord alone has through Divine truth united to Divine good, and the derivative power of those who are of His Spiritual and Celestial Kingdom. Signified, Explained.
The Angels are indeed in great power, but no one from himself. Nay, he who in Heaven believes that he is in power from himself, is deprived of it in a moment...
All power is in truths from good. Signified.
The power of God = Divine truth; and power, when said of the Lord, = all power, or omnipotence.

As Divine power is in truth from natural good, it is said, Ephraim is the strength of My head. The reason Divine power is through truth from good in the Natural, is that the Natural is the ultimate into which the interiors inflow...
Stir up Thy power () = to penetrate thither in light.

All power in the Spiritual World is from truth from good in the natural man. Signified. The reason all the power the spiritual man has is in this, is that the efficient cause is in the spiritual man, and the effect is in the natural man, and all the power of the efficient cause puts itself forth through the effect. That all the power of the spiritual man is in the Natural and through the Natural. Reference.
Power and strength () = omnipotence from Divine good through Divine truth... Power is said of Divine truth; and strength, of Divine good.
Thou hast taken Thy great power... = the instauration of the New Heaven and New Church... Explained.
(The great power of the dragon, and the cause of it. Signified, Explained.)

It has been said that falsities from evil have no power; but it is to be known that they have no power against truth from good... But the reason why falsities from evil have the power which is signified by the ten horns of the dragon, is that falsities from evil avail against those who are in falsities from evil. Explained.
The power of natural truth from spiritual. Signified, Described.

For all the power which belongs to truths in the natural man, is from the influx of truth and good from the spiritual man; that is, from the influx of Divine truth from the Lord through the spiritual man into the natural; for power belongs to the Lord alone, and He exercises it through the Divine truth which proceeds from Him. Explained point by point.
I. That the Lord has infinite power. Explained.
II. That the Lord has infinite power from Himself through His Divine truth. Explained.
III. That all power is together in ultimates; and that thence the Lord has infinite power from primes through ultimates. Explained.
IV. That Angels and men, in proportion as they are receptions of Divine truth from the Lord, in the same proportion are powers. Explained.
V. That power resides in the truths of the natural man, in proportion as this receives influx from the Lord through the spiritual man. Explained.
VI. That the truths of the natural man have nothing of power without this influx. Explained.
See Power.

The power of reasonings from the natural man, from fallacies, thus from falsities. Signified. In these there is indeed, in themselves, no power, because all power is in truths; but still there is much power in the falsities which are from the fallacies of the senses, and consequently in the reasonings from them, with the men of the Earth, before they are in truths from good. Explained. AE 783:2, Explained.
The dragon gave him his power, and his throne, and great Power () = that (such) through reasonings from fallacies strengthen their own doctrinals, and corroborate them, and thus powerfully seduce.
It is from this that those in falsities are called mighty, strong, etc.

Evil Spirits believe themselves to be mighty above all others, for the reason that they prevail against those who are in evils and the derivative falsities... But this power may be compared to an ant against an ant... the power of which is relative to their mutual forces...
There are some who acquire power by means of the Word. Explained.
Some acquire power by means of simulated affections of good and truth. Explained.
Some acquire power by means of representatives. Explained.

As all power belongs to the truths which are from good... nothing is more desired by evil Spirits than to draw good Spirits to their side, because so the evil are strong. But as soon as they are separated from them, they are in the falsities of their evil, and are then bereaved of all power.
As they (then) no longer have any power, they fall down into Hell.
As all power resides in the extreme...
The Angels say that they are in continual potency; and that there is never any lassitude after the act... but alacrity of life and cheerfulness of mind. SE 6055.
From love truly conjugial there is power and protection against the Hells. Explained. AE 1002:end.
Their two bodies are potentially so united that...
To deliver their power and Power to the beast () = that the Word is Divine truth, on which the Church depends as to doctrine. Explained.
The power of the Word in the sense of the letter is the power of opening Heaven... and it is the power of fighting against falsities and evils, and thus against the Hells. Explained.
If (Angels or devils) had a whit of power from themselves, Heaven would fall, Hell would become a chaos, and every man would perish with them.
The reason all power belongs to God... is that God alone is life...
Power, when predicated of the Lord, = omnipotence.
In ultimates is al strength, or all power, together. Explained.

All power in the Spiritual World is in the Divine truth proceeding from the Lord... and all the power of Divine truth consists in the sense of the letter. In the spiritual sense without the sense of the letter there is no power; but in the sense of the letter in which is the spiritual sense...

What is doctrinal confirmed by the sense of the letter as to genuine truth has power. The appearance of Divine truth also has power, but less power, as when it can agree with genuine truth. But the sense of the letter falsified has no power...

Redemption. 2. That the end of the Church is at hand when the power of evil through falsities begins to prevail over the power of good through truths, in the natural world; and at the same time the power of Hell over the power of Heaven. Chapter.
